bio.text: Warren Petersen is the Republican candidate for Arizona Attorney General in 2026 and currently serves as Arizona Senate President, representing District 14.
According to his campaign website, Petersen has served in the Arizona Legislature since 2012, when he was first elected to the House, and has held roles including House Majority Leader.

According to his campaign website and candidate statement, Petersen is a third-generation Gilbert resident and graduate of Gilbert High School, and received a bachelor's degree and a law degree from Arizona State University.
